output:
Implemented Axure-style interactions and a preview player.

### Data & engine
- **`src/studio/prototype/interactions.ts`** — event → case → action model, preview state, `applyAction` / `dispatchInteraction`, presets
- **`src/studio/prototype/interactions.test.ts`** — 5 engine tests
- **`src/studio/prototype/model.ts`** — optional `interactions` on elements + Zod parsing

### UI
- **`src/studio/prototype/inspector-interactions.tsx`** — Interactions tab (events, cases, actions, presets)
- **`src/studio/prototype/inspector.tsx`** — `interactions` tab
- **`src/studio/prototype/preview-player.tsx`** — fullscreen preview (pages, zoom, hotspots/notes, interaction handling)
- **`src/studio/prototype/canvas.tsx`** — lightning (⚡) badge on wired elements
- **`src/studio/prototype/builder.tsx`** — preview (`.` / ▶), preview screenshot to chat
- **`src/studio/prototype/toolbar.tsx`** — Play control
- **`src/shared/i18n.ts`** — interaction & preview strings (EN/RU)

**Actions supported:** open link, go to page, show/hide/toggle, set panel state, set text, set selected, scroll to, wait.

**Verification:** `npx tsc --noEmit` and `node --experimental-strip-types --test 'src/studio/prototype/*.test.ts'` pass (including `interactions.test.ts`).

Area «feature:office-studio-prototype»: earlier accepted tasks, newest first. Their decisions are in main; keep them unless this task changes them.
- 2026-10-17T21:51 prototype-context-menus: Prototype: unified mouse model and context menus in outline, pages, tabs, palette and canvas. Right-click opens a fitting context menu everywhere in the prototype builder, and left/right/double click behave the same across canvas, layers, pages and libraries.
- 2026-10-17T21:19 prototype-modifier-keys: Prototype: draw-by-drag tools and Shift/Alt/Cmd/Space modifiers like Figma/Axure/Photoshop. Shapes are drawn by dragging, and Shift, Alt, Cmd and Space behave as in Figma, Axure and Photoshop when drawing, resizing, moving and rotating.
- 2026-10-17T20:06 prototype-color-picker-fix: Prototype colour picker: effective defaults, tidy field row, rainbow hue and alpha tracks, portal popover with HEX/RGB. Choosing a colour is clear: the field shows the real colour, the picker has a rainbow hue bar, an alpha bar, HEX/RGB inputs and never runs off the panel.
- 2026-10-17T20:04 prototype-style-layout: Prototype Style panel: layout polish, no overlapping controls. The Style panel's controls never overlap and read clearly at any panel width.
- 2026-10-17T19:58 prototype-style-apply-fix: Fix: Style panel opacity (and other style fields) not applied on the canvas. Changing opacity or any other Style field immediately changes the element on the canvas, in PNG export and in Slides.
- 2026-10-17T19:56 prototype-align-icons: Prototype: real alignment icons in one row and proper tooltips. Alignment and distribution buttons use clear standard icons in one row with proper hover tooltips.
- 2026-10-17T18:27 prototype-inspector-native: Prototype inspector: native Axure-like Style panel with icons, pickers, fonts and colour picker. The Style tab is a compact native panel: icon align row, geometry grid, collapsible sections, font and weight pickers, text alignment icons and a real colour picker.
- 2026-10-17T18:25 prototype-screen-size: Prototype: single screen-size dropdown with device presets, compact W/H and colour swatch; tidy toolbar. Screen size is chosen in one place: a device dropdown with presets and orientation, compact W/H and a colour swatch; no duplicate device buttons.
- 2026-10-17T18:24 prototype-left-split: Prototype left pane: one draggable divider between Pages and Libraries, remove extra separators. The owner drags one divider to give the Libraries section more height; the left column has no stacked extra lines.
- 2026-10-17T18:18 prototype-templates: Prototype: Templates library with ready forms and UI patterns. The owner inserts ready forms and UI blocks (login, registration, checkout, header, pricing, table with filters…) from a Templates library.
- 2026-10-17T18:16 prototype-icons-fix: Fix Icons library: load Hugeicons data from the plugin server instead of a bare dynamic import. The Icons library, Icon elements and the icon picker show the actual icons.
- 2026-10-17T18:15 prototype-overlay-close: Prototype: proper close button and backdrop for side-pane overlays. In a narrow panel the side panes open as overlays with a clean close button that does not overlap the tabs.
